findings.title: Forecast prose says opex grows more slowly than revenue; assumptions do not show that across the horizon
findings.detail: Still open: the candidate is unchanged (note.md sha256 231445d2..., assumptions.json sha256 d48689ee... match manifest and review-01). note.md (Guidance and outlook, Judgment) still says the model lets operating expenses grow more slowly than revenue after FY2027Q3. assumptions.json opex_pct_revenue runs 0.0852, 0.0844, 0.0844, 0.0852. Recomputed from forecast.json: opex 9.201bn -> 10.027bn (+9.0%) -> 10.829bn (+8.0%) -> 11.697bn (+8.0%) against revenue +10%, +8%, +7%. Opex grows more slowly than revenue only in FY2027Q4, at the same rate in FY2028Q1 and faster in FY2028Q2, and the exit ratio equals the starting ratio. The numbers are correct, but the sentence overstates the operating leverage assumed.
findings.required_evidence: Sentence describes opex as roughly constant at about 8.4-8.5% of revenue, or assumptions changed to match the prose
